I had a pleasant stay at Hotel Red Flame Residency. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and comfortable. The staff was polite, helpful, and always ready to assist with any request. The hotel’s location is convenient — close to major attractions and easy to reach by public transport.

The amenities were satisfactory, offering good value for money. Room service was prompt, and the food quality was quite good. The overall ambiance was peaceful and suitable for both business and leisure travelers.

If you’re looking for an affordable yet comfortable place to stay with friendly service, Hotel Red Flame Residency is a great choice.
